title: Rubio: things flying over nuclear sites

tellings.quote: Marco Rubio, our Secretary of State, basically admits that we know somebody said, "What's the conspiracy you believe in most?" He goes, "There are things flying with impunity around our nuclear sites."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, was once asked what conspiracy he believed in most. According to Michels, Rubio answered that there are things flying with impunity around America's nuclear sites. If true, it would mean a top official is acknowledging unknown craft moving freely over the country's most guarded places.
